verdict.rationale: Event-triggered rules or automations (triggers, change-data hooks) are a fair axis for a database. The evidence pack shows no user-definable rules in Milvus that fire actions on events. Internal automatic behaviors, such as building an index when a slice hits a threshold or auto-converting text to sparse embeddings, are built-in system behavior rather than user-defined event rules, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
